88930:
I have received no word from High Arcanist Thalyssra for days!

We have had many mana problems lately, so there is a chance her message spells were simply not able to be received.
90705:
Are you curious about your world's history? Would you like to learn more?

Li Li Stormstout has started her Lorewalking apprenticeship. With all her travels, she has gathered many stories of important events and figures across Azeroth and beyond and is eager to share them!

Pay her a visit in your capital city!
92181:
{name}... I need you to attend to a matter in the city.

I've received word from Knight Captain Solara that there's been an incident in the Gardens of Remembrance. She reports elves have begun acting out violently, causing coalesced anguish to manifest and terrorize the residents.

You can use the crystalline vessel to reclaim the coalesced anguish and soothe the elves whose minds have crumbled.

So much of the magic will weigh heavy upon you, but I'm confident you have the strength.
93385:
Remnants of the Twilight's Blade scurry like rats through the Arcway tunnels beneath Suramar.

Exterminate the vermin before they spread.
93409: <The fallen scout's body bears terrible wounds, but still clutches tightly to a report detailing an imminent Vilebranch attack on Atal'Aman.>
93511:
He took him! Finley...big...purple...man!

<Reno is clearly distraught and both physically and emotionally exhausted.>
93719:
There are three Seeker classes in Decor Duel, but everyone starts off with the Spellbreaker kit. Don't worry--you can earn access to the others.

Some fundamentals: you can break the shield of a disguised hider's illusion by using Dispel Magic. Once the hider has been marked as Found, you'll have a brief window to Tag them, taking them out of the match.

My statue has been enchanted to outfit you with a Spellbreaker kit. Once outfitted, use Dispel Magic to find and tag decoys hiding around here.
94432:
We have only just begun to scratch the surface of how powerful your gear can become!

However, every piece of equipment has a limit to how much it can be upgraded. The more powerful an item is at its baseline, the more powerful it will become as we upgrade it. An item's upgrade track determines which crests we must use to upgrade it.

Bring me a piece of Veteran equipment this time along with some Veteran Dawncrests. Just like before, Cuzolth will help you upgrade the item using those crests.
94868:
Jan'alai is a hen! And dat means eggs!

De eggs of de loa are volatile! Dey must be hatched carefully. My family carried dis honor for generations, but de tradition died when my older brothers followed de false promises of Zul'jin. Sadly, I am de only brother left, and we need two hatchers for de ritual!

Find my niece, Shaja, down by de shore. She is too young to know de ritual, but de loa's favor flows through her veins as it did my brothers'. It is time for her to know this honor.
94870:
De eggs are nearly ready!

<Brek glances eagerly at both clutches of eggs.>

Ya may know somethin' about dis, eh? Jan'alai tells me so. What ya lack in blood, ya make up for in spirit. Help me teach Shaja! Ya spirit alone is not enough for dis ritual. De eggs are imbued with de power of de loa herself and will burst with fiery energy!

We can protect ya from dis, but first we need feathers. Loa feathers! Collect dem from around de temple... unless ya dare ask de loa herself!
94869:
We will soon be blessed with eggs! Jan'alai has told me so. And once dem eggs hatch, we'll have many hungry mouths to feed! Dey will crave somethin' soft, delicate, and pungent.

<Brek eyes you up and down.>

Ya best scurry down to de shore and find somethin' to tempt de hatchlings with or dey may take a nibble out of you!

<Brek laughs.>
94882:
All is ready! I will now guide ya both through de hatchin' ceremony!

Talk to Shaja and she will use de feathers to protect ya from dem powerful loa energies.
94883:
I know my uncle can seem... off at times. His talk of de loa always felt like childhood stories to me.

But ever since Jan'alai returned, I feel her energy too! She flickers, she smolders, she burns red hot. She also brings warmth, light, and life!

But what I feel from her right now is distress--dat of a mother hen counting her chicks but comin' up short.

Let's check on de hatchlings. We can cover more ground if we split up.
94954:
Today, celebrate da Darkspear footrunners. 

Long ago, our footrunners ran 'round all da troll empire deliverin' important messages. Dey carried their messages through battle an' storm an' were famous for dey courage. 

Today we be celebratin' not dey courage in war, but da courage of some of da messages dey carried--messages of peace an' hope for a better world.

Help us send a message of hope by joinin' our symbolic run ta Silvermoon. 

Ya be ready? Well go, mon!
95009:
Have you heard about the race today?

Thousands of trolls are gathering to run to Silvermoon City for a celebration!

Kalaya could tell you more. They're setting up at the Echo Isles now!
95071:
<The enchanted scroll shimmers with an arcane glint, the text vaguely resembling the elven language.

You presume it is written in the language of the naga, though the arcane-laced ink appears to move the letters around the scroll.

Perhaps a mage in Silvermoon can help you translate it.>
95271: At last, we've collected enough power to fully weave the Nilhammer!
96051:
The Legion keystone and the dark particles you found gave us a needle in the endless, vast haystack of the Twisting Nether.

With the Cynosure of Twilight, the artifact used to open the way to the Voidstorm, we can thread this needle and open a rift to our enemy's doorstep.

With the components in place, my riftwardens stand at the ready.

Take up the Cynosure and point and be ready, {name}.
96052:
The energy from the Hal'hadar battery core and dark particles allowed us to piece together a faint trail of nether energy.

With the Cynosure of Twilight, we can illuminate and ignite this trail, taking us directly to our enemy's doorstep.

The anchors are in place and my riftwalkers await your move.

Take up the Cynosure and point. Let us see what awaits us on the other side.
96224:
Magisters' Terrace is home to many mysterious artifacts.

Among them is a relic once central to our pursuit of magical knowledge. A few years ago, the relic fell into a state of dormancy.

After the Dawnwell reignited, this artifact began to stir. Upon returning it to the Lycaneum for study, the relic unleashed chaos upon the library.

I believe your unique expertise may be helpful in quelling this chaos.
96225:
For the last few decades, a dormant artifact laid beneath the halls of Magisters' Terrace.

Once serving as a beacon of knowledge to the Magisters, the artifact abruptly fell silent some decades ago.

After the Dawnwell's rebirth, the artifact reawakened. When we returned it to the Lycaneum for study, it unleashed chaos upon the library.

Your assistance, and discretion, would be most appreciated.
96227:
When the Omnium began to stir in its vault, we thought to move it here for observation. Evidently, this was a bad idea.

The arcane magics seeping out are causing chaos.

Folios casting all sorts of incomplete spells, arcane sparks running amok--even the candle flames have sprung to life!

But we cannot simply destroy them, as the magics here are too volatile. I have procured a ward-lance from the arsenal of the spellbreakers. It will dispel the volatile magic.

Here, take it. And do be careful.
96229:
After reclaiming Silvermoon, the Magisters torched Dar'Khan's personal study and dwellings within the city walls.

I had thought I had found everything I needed the first time I searched this place, but now...

It seems that Dar'Khan left some secrets.

This portal will take us to them. I do not know what we will find on the other side. Be on your guard.
96233:
For years, as Silvermoon and its people changed, this relic sat in a vault beneath the Terrace, unresponsive and dormant.

We may never truly understand why the relic fell silent when it did or why it refused the prince's call, but perhaps in time, we might.

Let us hope the missing Magicule and the key-cipher will be enough to restore it.

Are you ready, {name}?
96389:
While you were attuning the gem to the Void, I managed to acquire one of Impotus's projection devices. 

We're going to use it to lure him to us, then prevent him from escaping with the gem. 

Not here, though. Let us find somewhere more discrete.
96410:
Those who sought to learn from the Omnium had to contribute to it.

While most Magisters studied within the Terrace, a select few were appointed as "Seekers of Wisdom."

Seekers would search for new and foreign magic to contribute to the Omnium's vast index for study.

Given your... adventurous experience, I think you'd make an excellent seeker.

If you're interested, the Grand Magister will explain more.
96441:
The nature of the Dawnwell has sparked a question among the minds of Magisters' Terrace:

If magic can corrupt and suffuse other magics, how will the Dawnwell affect the ley lines branching out from it?

With inquiry, comes experiment.

The Ritual Sites in Quel'Thalas use the ley lines to fuel their magic.

Disrupt these sites and retrieve samples of the arcana you find.
96442:
Unfortunately, most of the measurable samples were expunged by the Ritual Site's excessive energy.

If we are to accurately measure the various magics seeping into the ley lines, we'll need samples from a broader, less concentrated source.

I am told the Farstriders continue to route the void strikes across Quel'Thalas.

Bring me coalesced ley energy from any of the assaulting forces.
96443:
Thanks to your efforts, we've isolated the effects of trace amounts of foreign magic coalescing with the ley lines.

Our next phase is to compare these results against a pure sample of magic coalescing with the same energy.

Your task is to track down a primessence of magic--be it arcane, Void, Light, or other--and acquire it from its deadly source.

Good luck, {name}.
96444:
Although it made an excellent catalyst, the primessence you retrieved revealed a factor we did not account for.

The alien nature of the Void and ethereal magic used in their assaults proved incompatible with the experiment.

We need a sample of their magic if we are to make any progress--not from the assaults here in Quel'Thalas, but from the source of their attacks.

I am told these enemies strike from off-world staging grounds. Good luck, {name}.
96473:
Like all domanaar, Imperator Pertinax sees himself only as a predator and never the prey.

Unfortunately, our prey is well-guarded in his Void Acropolis.

If you manage to gather enough allies and catch the imperator off guard, we'll deal a crushing blow to our enemies.

Move swiftly and cautiously, {name}, and ensure you have backup before engaging Pertinax.
96475:
The domanaar Impotus sounds like he can be persuaded to set his sights elsewhere. 

Speaking with them directly will be challenging. They are distrustful, even of one another, as you can see from their projection devices. 

We must set a trap.

Take this soul gem and hunt the beings that inhabit the Acropolis. We will use the Void energy of this place against them.
96472:
The Hal'hadar may not know we are here yet, but they still hold the advantage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge and surrounded by a small army.

If you can rally enough allies and catch their leaders off guard, we will deal a devastating blow before they know what hit them.

Proceed with caution, {name}, and make sure you are not alone.
96497:
The domanaar are more entrenched here than we thought and these storms refuse to relent even for a moment.

We've finally figured out how to hijack their portal network for short range traversal thanks to your efforts setting up the rift slippers. Now we just need help setting up our portal bridges.

Here are four strategic locations, including this outpost, for you to set up the portal bridges. Once active, you'll be able to more swiftly respond to threats as they arise.

Time to get to work.
96496:
During our surveys of this iced desert, our scouts identified two areas worth keeping an eye on, but with a major problem: they're only accessible through single points of entry.

Before I'm comfortable sending out more forces, we need to secure their exits.

We've been working on teleportation crystals for faster local travel that leverage the domanaar's existing portal network, and we're close to a solution. You just need to field test them.

Set up these prototype rift slippers and report back.
96538:
I'm sure there is much we can do to help you with your problem.

Scattered out there is sure to be plenty of old demonic artifacts.

Search for fel embers and bring me back a few handfuls.
96567:
To understand the Hal'hadar's intentions with this world, we will need to secure information.

Knowing how they operate, they've restricted their data consoles with security measures in place.

<Y'mera smiles as she hands you a rune-carved crystal.>

This decrypter will automatically navigate their security. If you choose, you can engage the manual option to hasten the protocol.

Just remember to ignore any security warnings. My device can and will bypass it.
96565:
You say it's still cold out there?

I can't say that I noticed. It's one of the few upsides of my current physical state.

There may still be more that can be done to help counteract the storms further. Hunt down stronger creatures and search their remains.

Let us once more foray into the past and acquire old legion technology. And by we, I mean you.
96572:
<From the runic communicator, you see a projection of a winged mechanical suit piloted by an ethereal. A voice emits from the device:

"Nullframe Soul-Fuse unsuccessful. Deployment from the Nexus Port halted. Troubleshooting in progress."

Whatever weapon the Hal'hadar created seems to be malfunctioning at the Transit Hub.

Intercepting and translocating the weapon back to Y'mera would deprive the ethereals of another weapon.>
96574:
The tomb is called Vilaldoun. It means "island of the restful." Its entrance lies on the northern coast.

We know the Hal'hadar have established an extraction site outside the crypt, harvesting the local flora there to fuel their research.

As you approach, you will be met with heavy resistance.

Cut a path through their ranks while we establish a footing inside and meet us within.
96578:
Although she escaped, we have denied the architect her prototype... for now.

This Soul Lattice is fractured, but the core within still hums with a faint energy.

Perhaps this vigilant's soul yet remains...

If we hurry, perhaps Veraan and her brother can help stabilize the damage to preserve it.

I will regroup with Y'mera and Allari and meet you back at camp.
96577:
The architect leading their operation has found a single vigilant with an intact construct core.

The other vigilants in this chamber appear to be depleted.

If she succeeds in creating the Soul Lattice, the Hal'hadar will possess the means to turn our warframes into new armored bodies for their soldiers.

We must stop her now and recover the Soul Lattice prototype.
96576:
Defiling tombs... harnessing innocent souls as fuel...

The Hal'hadar are no better than demons.

If left unchecked, the ethereals will pilfer every grave and altar down here.

I may bear the title of "Souleater," but it doesn't mean I can't honor the dead in this forgotten place.

Recover the tributes the ethereals have stolen. Bring them to Tala'saan in the lower chamber.
96585:
We should first see how the local wildlife has adapted to these spores.

I would say return with a selection of fauna, but I'm not sure such fauna would be compliant with such a request.

Instead, you should just gather the pertinent parts that I would need to review for such a request.

Return with their lungs.
96708:
It may not seem like many, but the allies we've secured will have to be enough.

It's time we move out.

Our forces are gathering at the Howling Ridge. The energies of the Voidstorm will allow us to open the way to these worlds.

I will meet you there. There is something here I still require for our mission.
96712:
Like all domanaar, those stationed here on Val see themselves only as predators and never the prey.

This gives us an opportunity we must not squander.

Most of Pertinax's forces are occupied elsewhere or off-world, leaving our target exposed.

The imperator holds court in the bowels of this Acropolis.

Strike him down before he can rally his armies. End his threat once and for all.
96711:
Like all domanaar, Imperator Pertinax sees himself only as a predator and never the prey.

Unfortunately, our prey is well-guarded in his Void Acropolis.

If you manage to gather enough allies and catch the imperator off guard, we'll deal a crushing blow to our enemies.

Move swiftly and cautiously, {name}, and ensure you have backup before engaging Pertinax.
96710:
The Hal'hadar think they are alone here.

Normally, I'd prioritize reconnaissance, but there is an opportunity we must leverage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge.

The bulk of the Hal'hadar appear to be spread across the swamp, which means their leaders are exposed.

If we strike them both down now, we deal a devastating blow to their operation.
96714:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {name}.
96709:
The Hal'hadar may not know we are here yet, but they still hold the advantage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge and surrounded by a small army.

If you can rally enough allies and catch their leaders off guard, we'll deal a devastating blow before they know what hits them.

Proceed with caution, {name}, and make sure you are not alone.
96713:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {name}.
96716:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {name}.
96727:
Our effort to thwart the Void Assaults in Eversong and Zul'Aman have seen much success, but if we do not find a way to stop our aggressors from coming to our lands, they will bleed us until we can no longer stand.

Riftblade Maella has recently discovered the location of two of our enemies' bases. She seeks to take the fight to them. Will you aid her strike team?

Your efforts will not go unnoticed in these dark times!
96744:
Hello! Here's a trick to help you bounce on the purple mushrooms around here. You'll need it, because...

I want some canopy specimens from the sporerays above us. Bounce up there, get some specimens, then come back down and I'll teach you how to ALWAYS bounce on those mushrooms.
96745:
Now, practice using aerospores. They're up there too if you know where to look. Use them to shoot through the air!

You'll need to bounce on mushrooms to get up to the spores and see them. Once you're up there, pass through some aerospores and find out what they do!
96809:
Maneuvering through this spore-infested rock is quickly becoming a chore, I'm sure you would agree.

Thankfully, I've figured out a way to make use of the existing Manaforge Translocator network that was so thoughtfully built prior to our arrival.

I can show you how to "activate" them for our use. You can start with the one we... translocated to camp.
96845: You have to try this Lightforge Hookshot! Here, take this loaner one. To learn the ropes, use it on some mushrooms and aerospores around here. Come back and I'll give you a Hookshot for keeps.
97031:
<A brief glint sparkling in the shadows catches your eye.

As you pick up the object, the gem in its center flickers briefly, strange alien runes flashing across its surface.

For a moment, you see a flickering recorded projection of a male draenei mouthing silent words.

Y'mera will definitely be interested in this object.>
97036:
Well then, it seems our goals are more aligned than before. You've impressed me. With Ignedus and Periculus dealt with, all that remains is my former associate.

You will find Gladius Reginax atop that high platform, observing her quarry. She already knows you're coming, so don't aim to surprise her. There's only one way up there for you anyway: through that portal in the Glacial Reservoir.

I will play my part and join you. A symbol of our... collaboration.
97037:
We have a problem, {name}.

The hologem you found revealed much about our people's time on this world and who the vigilants were in life.

Who they were is not the problem, but rather the possessions they carried within their chassis.

Possessions now in the hands of the Soul Architect who, as far as my scouts can tell, has left Naigtal.

Archmage Y'mera will explain in greater detail.
97072:
The Nexus-Captain is just over that hill, unaware of our arrival.

Attacking now would catch his army off guard... and likely result in our demise.

No matter what, we will need allies if we are to succeed.

Use this beacon to return to our invasion point.

By now, Y'mera has likely brought in the rest of our forces to support us.

Speak with Maella when you arrive.
97085:
I hear your scouts talk of dangerous creatures and foes they have faced. 

It makes me wonder if you could defeat them? Why don't you go and try? It will certainly help your efforts here.

I hope to see you return mostly intact.
97215:
We have struck a major blow against our enemies. Still, they continue their assaults.

Decimus and my riftwardens have targeted another world from which they launch these attacks.

The bulk of our forces have temporarily withdrawn to the Voidstorm so that we may begin our assault on this second world.

Our strike team awaits us at the Howling Ridge.
97086:
I hear your scouts talk of dangerous creatures and foes they have faced. 

It makes me wonder if you could defeat them? Why don't you go and try? It will certainly help your efforts here.

I hope to see you return mostly intact.
